items.stem: What did the grandfather take from the attic?
items.answer: The grandfather took an invisible chair from the attic.
Yes, the biggest challenge Mario will face is to sit on the invisible chair.

items.stem: Will Mario be able to use the magic?
items.answer: Mario was a brave and determined boy, so he will be able to use the magic as he has to win the bet.

items.stem: How was Mario able to find his real friends?
items.answer: When Mario did not fall on the ground while he was trying to sit on the magical chair, his friends, Guneet, Asma and Deepa held him in their arms.

items.stem: Do you think the magic chair test was good? Why do you say so?
items.answer: Yes, the magic chair test was good as it helped Mario to find his real friends.

items.stem: What does Friends for life' mean to you?
items.answer: The term Friends for life' means friends for complete life in every situation. They show genuine concern when you face challenges or are struggling.
